atAGlance: Thịt kho tàu is pork and eggs braised in coconut water, fish sauce, caramelized sugar, and pepper until the broth turns glossy and savory-sweet.
whatItIs: Thịt kho tàu is pork belly and eggs braised in coconut water, fish sauce, and caramel until sweet-salty and tender. It is home-style food made for rice.
howToEnjoy: Spoon the braising liquid over rice, then balance rich pork with pickles, greens, or soup if served. The egg soaks up the caramel-salty broth.
howLocalsOrder: Order thịt kho tàu when you want a homestyle pork braise. Ask for extra rice or more egg if you want to stretch the coconut-water caramel flavor.
worthKnowing: This dish belongs on southern Vietnam family meals and Tết tables, even when restaurants serve it year-round.
goodToKnow: This is family-meal food, not a creamy coconut curry. Coconut water adds gentle sweetness and depth; spoon the braising liquid over rice.
travelerCaution: Contains pork, egg, and fish sauce.
